title: Speculative Decoding Acceptance
signature: def speculative_accept(draft_tokens, q, p, u_accept, u_sample) -> tuple
hints: Walk the draft left to right. Token x at position i is accepted when u_accept[i] < p[i, x] / q[i, x].
On the first rejection, sample a replacement from max(0, p[i] - q[i]) (unnormalized is fine) with u_sample[i], then stop: later draft tokens are discarded.
If all K drafts are accepted you get one extra token for free, sampled from p[K] with u_sample[K].
Inverse CDF: c = np.cumsum(w); token = np.searchsorted(c, u * c[-1], side='right').
